trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed with status `rolled_out`, and the service now reports `healthy: true` with error rate 0.002.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged. (The first attempt was rate-limited; the retry succeeded.)

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback was to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
